answer_1.quote: We evaluate several recent vision-and-language models on the tasks of referring expression generation and comprehension, including ... The speaker describes the location of the blue sphere ... We collect a dataset of 2,970 human-written referring expressions grounded in 1,485 generated scenes.

answer_2.quote: Our main metric is communicative success: for each scene, did the pair of agents successfully coordinate on the target referent?

answer_4.quote: We recruit 194 crowdworkers on Prolific ... Speakers are presented with a prompt ... Listeners first click a button that reveals their view of the scene and a referring expression. They click on the referent they believe to be the target ... We record both the click position and the time taken ...
answer_4.guideline: Listeners select the referent they believe matches the speaker's description by clicking on it; success is measured by whether the selected referent is the intended target.
